reasoning:
Since this is the first report with no prior edits to conflict with, I'll commit the report's changes directly while keeping the rules general. I need to carefully craft edits that quote exact passages, like the target_cube annotator prompt describing the cube's position as the one marked "held in the gripper" or that disappears from the table list during the demonstration step.

I'm revising the location-tracking rule: the cube sits where it's placed on the table at the start, gets returned to nearly its original spot after lifting, and its position updates to match the nearest table cube (within ~10px) whenever it's resting, staying frozen while held in the gripper. I'll replace this whole passage, along with the holding rule, the "Never point" clause, and the required-count sentence for subgoal instructions.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: 'pick up ... again' means 1 pick-up; 'for two times' means 2 pick-ups.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: 'pick up ... again' means 1 pick-up; 'for N times' (two, three, ...) means N pick-ups.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: pointing at target_cube (the position of the cube that the demonstration picked up, derived from the demonstration steps at the first decision step).
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: pointing at target_cube (the position of the cube that the demonstration picked up, derived from the demonstration steps at the first decision step and tracked through the shuffle swaps).

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: - If the scene at this decision step shows the gripper raised with fingers partly closed (about 46% open, not 100%) and the cube held in the gripper or missing from the table list, the robot is holding the cube: choose B: put it down. - Otherwise (fingers 100% open, all cubes on the table):
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: - If the scene at this decision step shows the gripper raised with fingers partly closed (about 46% open, not 100%), the robot is holding the cube, regardless of the table list (the held cube is usually still listed at its old position): choose B: put it down. - Otherwise (fingers 100% open; the robot holds nothing even if a cube is listed as 'lifted off the table', which is a cube just released and settling):

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: choose A: pick up the cube, pointing at target_cube (the current table position of that cube);
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: choose A: pick up the cube, pointing at target_cube as updated at this step (after a put-down this is the current position of the cube the execution steps showed released);

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Never point at any cube other than the one nearest target_cube.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Always point at target_cube as updated at this step.

edits.modify_from: Position [y, x] of the cube to pick. At the first decision step (memory empty), read the DEMONSTRATION STEPS: find the cube that appears as 'held in the gripper' (or disappears from the table list while the gripper fingers are about 46% open), note where it was on the table just before the gripper came down on it, and write the position of the cube that sits closest to that spot in the scene at the start of execution (the cube is set down and the shuffle returns it to nearly the same place). At every later step, if the scene at this decision step lists a cube on the table within about 10 px of the carried value, write that cube's current position; if the cube is currently held in the gripper, copy the carried value unchanged. e.g. [93, 140]
edits.modify_to: Position [y, x] of the cube the demonstration picked, at its current table position. At the first decision step (memory empty), read the DEMONSTRATION STEPS: find the frame where the gripper is lowest (height about 0.02) and the fingers first read about 46%; the picked cube is the cube listed nearest the gripper's own [y, x] there (the 'held in the gripper' line in the following frames confirms it; a cube merely vanishing from the list while the gripper hovers over it is occlusion, not a pick). Then follow that cube's identity through every later demonstration frame, including the shuffle, by matching each cube to its nearest position in the previous frame; when two cubes move at once they are exchanging places, so the picked cube ends where its arc ends, not where it started (two swaps of the same pair put it back). Write its position in the scene at the start of execution. At every later decision step: if the execution steps shown contain a cube 'held in the gripper' that is then released (fingers reopen to 100% at height about 0.02), write that cube's position in the scene at this decision step; otherwise write the position of the listed cube within about 10 px of the carried value, or copy the carried value if none is listed. Ignore 'lifted off the table' lines. e.g. [85, 109]

edits.modify_from: Count of completed pick-ups. Write 0 at the first decision step (memory empty). At any later step, look at the last frame shown (the scene at this decision step): if the gripper is raised (height about 0.14 or more) with fingers partly closed (about 46% open, not 100%) and a cube is held in the gripper or missing from the table list, write the carried value plus one; otherwise write the carried value unchanged. e.g. 1
edits.modify_to: Count of completed grasps. Write 0 at the first decision step (memory empty). At any later step, write the carried value plus one if the execution steps shown include a frame with the gripper at about height 0.02 and fingers going from 100% to about 46% (or any 'is held in the gripper' line) AND the scene at this decision step shows the gripper raised (height about 0.14 or more) with fingers about 46% open (not 100%). Do not require the cube to be missing from the table list; it is usually still listed at its old position. Otherwise, and always when the fingers at the scene are 100% open (even if a cube is listed 'lifted off the table'), copy the carried value unchanged. e.g. 2

edits.modify_from: Position [y, x] of the cube the demonstration picked up: the cube that is listed as 'held in the gripper' (or vanishes from the table list while the gripper is closed) during the DEMONSTRATION STEPS, located where it sits on the table in the scene at the start of execution (it is set back down at nearly the spot it was lifted from, and the shuffle at the end of the demonstration returns it there). 'Lifted off the table' lines are ignored. e.g. [85, 109]

edits.modify_from: Count of completed pick-ups in the execution so far. It is 0 at the first decision step. revision.refused: The request from two steps to keep the carried target_cube rather than refresh it from the cube seen released in the execution steps is not committed: the carried value was wrong only because the first-step derivation ignored the shuffle swaps, and the released cube is the demonstration's cube in every episode, so the refresh is kept. The request to copy the point exactly from the scene list is not committed, since recorded points differ from listed positions by a pixel or two and no exactness rule would help.
